gap: No result ChatGPT got states the measured no-load idle draw of the candidate stations. The Solar Lab measured these with the inverter on: BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 9.5 W, EcoFlow DELTA 2 Max 13.6 W, Jackery Explorer 2000 v2 17 W, Anker SOLIX C2000 Gen 2 18 W and EcoFlow DELTA 3 Max 27 W. Over a 72-hour fridge trip that is roughly 680 to 1,940 Wh lost before the fridge draws anything. No result says either that the Anker SOLIX S2000, ChatGPT's #2 pick for a 12V fridge, has no 12V car socket.
standout_why: I read solarwaypoint.com's C2000 Gen 2 vs AC200L vs DELTA 2 Max comparison (2026-01-24). It has no measured figures at all: no tested capacity, no efficiency, no idle draw. It only says the Anker has 'low idle consumption', with no number. ChatGPT's answer gives a generic '85% usable' assumption and never mentions idle draw. It recommends the S2000 for a 12V fridge, and the DELTA 3 Max with 'confirm 12V output compatibility'. Three of the 16 pages I could not read: buyerdecision.com returned 403, and gearranking.com and stationarena.com failed on a certificate error. Gearranking's title says 'Tested Capacity' for the DELTA 2 Max, so it may hold one measured capacity figure for that one model. It would not hold a side-by-side idle comparison. The manuals ChatGPT cited are specs, not measurements.
decides: For a 3-day 12V fridge run, standby loss matters about as much as battery size. At The Solar Lab's inverter-on idle figures, the DELTA 3 Max (ChatGPT's top pick) could lose about 1,944 Wh over 72 h, nearly its whole 2,048 Wh. The Elite 200 V2 would lose about 684 Wh. The Elite 200 V2 also has the best measured efficiency, 94% against the DELTA 3 Max's 79%. That supports the Elite 200 V2 as our #1 pick among stations that have a 12V socket. The Anker S2000 has the lowest idle of all (6 W, or 2 W with the inverter off), but it has no 12V car socket. It should be dropped from a 12V-fridge list or marked as AC-adapter only. Whatever the station, shoppers should switch the AC inverter off and run the fridge from the 12V port.
